items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: Well, the outstanding was Emmanuel Parais, one of the best cornet players in the New Lane.

ctx.x: Now what about trumpet players? You named several of them to me a minute ago. Who were some of the outstanding?
Well, the outstanding was Emmanuel Parais, one of the best cornet players in the New Lane.
Do you remember where he lived about? Is it near your house?
